title: event-driven-shotgun-workload-replicator-with-adaptive-sampling
author: Marta Silva
description: Motivation: reproduce short, high-concurrency 'shotgun' bursts observed in production that currently evade our existing synthetic suites. This PR introduces an event-driven workload replicator that replays burst patterns with per-actor variability and an adaptive sampling controller to prioritize rare-but-high-impact traces. Design: actor-based generator (python) that accepts a compact burst descriptor, a sampling policy engine that adjusts sampling rates based on observed tail-latency and error rates, and a telemetry fanout reporter that publishes compressed trace bundles to the bench pipeline and a parallel S3-compatible archive for offline profiling. Includes new config schema (sample_policies.yaml) and a small shim to plug the replicator into the existing runner harness. How to run: `make bench-shotgun` starts the generator in local mode; passes are gated by a new integration test that runs on the CI bench matrix. Backwards compatibility: default behavior is off; seed policies are conservative; no changes to existing synthetic generators. Related work: BENCH-89 added burst capture tooling; ENG-4217 tracks rollout to Dedicated perf suite. Checklist: add tests, document config, validate sampling stability, ensure telemetry size bounds.

review_conversation: Evan Cho (2024-10-20): Nice shape. Two questions: can sampling policy hit state explosion if many distinct trace keys arrive? Please add eviction bounds.
Marta Silva (2024-10-21): Added LRU eviction and max-policy count; documented defaults in sample_policies.yaml. Replied with inline comments on eviction behavior.
Priya Nair (2024-10-24): Telemetry fanout looks heavy; what are the size guarantees? We should gzip and limit bundle size to avoid OOM in the bench pipeline.
Marta Silva (2024-10-25): Fanout now writes gzipped ndjson bundles, max bundle size 16MB; added retry/backoff and backpressure metrics. Provided benchmark numbers in PR body.
ci_checks: ci/bench-integration (bench-shotgun): fail -> rerun -> pass (fixed harness race)
bench-suite-regression: pass (no perf regressions on sample seeds)
release_notes: Added event-driven shotgun workload replicator and adaptive sampling engine. New bench-shotgun target for reproducing short bursts; telemetry fanout to archive compressed bundles. Default disabled for routine runs. Useful for diagnosing tail-latency incidents and building targeted regressions.
notes_for_operators: When enabling in shared bench clusters, set sample_policies.max_policy_count to 500 and telemetry_fanout.max_bundle_bytes to 16MB to avoid memory pressure. Monitor bench.replica.concurrent_runs metric.
